sloka: ततो रुद्रैर्महाघोरैः सङ्गम्याथ निशाचरः ।प्रयुद्धस्तैश्च सङ्ग्रामे क्षतः शस्त्रैर्निरन्तरम् ।। ७.२८.३६ ॥
transliteration: tato rudrairmahāghoraiḥ saṅgamyātha niśācaraḥ ।prayuddhastaiśca saṅgrāme kṣataḥ śastrairnirantaram ।। 7.28.36 ॥

translations.english: Then, the night-wanderer Kumbhakarna, having encountered and fought with the extremely terrible Rudras in battle, was continuously wounded by their weapons.
translations.hindi: तुम शूलपाणि, दृष केतु, नेता, गोप्ता, हरहरि, जटी, मुण्डी, शिखण्डी, लकुटी और सहायशा हो
